items.title: 33.1 Properties and Quality of Water (pani ki properties aur quality) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 33.1 (PDF 247-249); the water-molecule drawing is our own.

blocks.text: Pani ki chemical aur physical properties (khasiyatein) samajhna zaroori hai, kyun ke inhi se pata chalta hai ke darya, jheel waghera (water bodies) mein pollution (aaloodgi) kis qism ki aur kitni hai. Pani ka molecule (H₂O) permanent dipole hai: is ke O wale sire par thora negative (δ⁻) aur H wale siron par thora positive (δ⁺) charge hota hai. Yehi polarity pani ko aisi khaas properties deti hai jo zindagi aur mahol ke liye zaroori hain. Pani ke structure (banawat) se nikalne wali kuch khaas (peculiar) properties neeche hain.

blocks.alt: Darmiyan mein pani ka aik molecule: surkh O par delta-minus aur dono neele H par delta-plus. Oopar wale molecule ka H darmiyani O se, aur darmiyani molecule ke dono H neeche wale do molecules ke O se purple dashed lakeeron (hydrogen bonds) se jure hain.
blocks.caption: Pani ka polar molecule aur hydrogen bonds (hamari drawing; kitab is hisse mein koi figure nahi chhapti).
blocks.long_description: Oxygen electrons ko zyada khenchta hai, is liye O sira thora manfi (delta-minus) aur H sire thore musbat (delta-plus) hote hain. Aik molecule ka H doosre molecule ke O ki taraf kashish (attraction) mehsoos karta hai: yehi hydrogen bond hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Darmiyan wale molecule ko dekhein: O par δ⁻ aur dono H par δ⁺ hai. Aik molecule ka δ⁺ H doosre molecule ke δ⁻ O ki taraf khinchta hai; purple dashed lakeerein yahi hydrogen bonds hain. Inhi bonds ki wajah se pani ki specific heat aur heat of vaporisation zyada hai, aur pani ions ko gher kar ghol leta hai.
i. Thermal Stability (temperature jaldi na badalna)

Polarity ki wajah se pani ke molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds bante hain. Hydrogen bonding ki wajah se pani ki specific heat capacity aur heat of vaporisation dono zyada hain. Matlab large bodies of water (bari jheelein, darya, samandar) thermally stable hain: un ka temperature jaldi upar neeche nahi hota.
ii. Unique Solvent Abilities (ghol lene ki khaas salahiyat)

Polarity ki wajah se pani bohat se ionic substances ka achha solvent (gholne wala) hai, jaise metal ions, nitrates (NO₃⁻) aur phosphates (PO₄³⁻); pani ke molecules ions ko charon taraf se gher lete hain. Pani polar organic compounds bhi ghol leta hai, is liye bohat se pesticides aur herbicides aasani se water cycle (pani ke chakkar) mein pohanch jate hain, wahan der tak rehte hain aur bioaccumulation (jaandaron ke jism mein jama hote jana) karte hain.
iii. Amphoteric Nature (acid aur base dono)

Pani acid bhi ban sakta hai aur base bhi; yeh baat pani ki quality ke liye ahem hai. Pani ki self-ionisation (Kw = 1.0 × 10⁻¹⁴, 25°C par) pH scale ki bunyaad hai. Zyada tar aquatic life (pani ke jaandaar) pH ke upar neeche hone (pH fluctuations) se bohat affect hoti hai. Misal: acid rain (tezabi barish) mein sulphur dioxide (SO₂) aur nitrogen oxides (NOₓ) ghule hote hain; yeh pani mein hydronium ions (H₃O⁺) ki concentration barha dete hain. Yeh acidity zehreeli heavy metal compounds, jaise aluminium hydroxide aur lead salts, ko sediments (tah ki mitti) se nikal kar pani mein le aati hai: protonation se un ki solubility (ghulne ki salahiyat) barh jati hai, ya woh mineral surfaces (mineral ki satah) se hat jate hain.
iv. Oxygen in Water (pani mein oxygen)

Pani mein oxygen gas ka bara kirdar hai. Is se pani ki quality aur pollution ka level pata chalta hai. Pani mein oxygen ko us ke mukhtalif roles (kaamon) ke hisaab se teen tarah samjha aur naapa jata hai.

items: Dissolved oxygen (DO): pani mein ghuli hui woh oxygen jo aquatic organisms (pani ke jaandaron) ke saans lene ke liye mojood hai. Yeh pani ki quality aur aquatic ecosystem ki sehat ka ahem indicator (nishani) hai. Zyada DO aam taur par saaf pani batati hai; kam DO pollution ya organic matter ke zyada galne (decomposition) ki nishani ho sakti hai.

Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD): woh oxygen jo microorganisms ko pani ka organic matter torne ke liye ek specific (muqarrar) waqt mein chahiye, aam taur par 20°C par paanch din. Yeh organic pollution ka ahem indicator hai. Zyada BOD = zyada organic matter = zyada pollution; aisi pollution dissolved oxygen khatam kar ke aquatic life ko nuqsan deti hai.

Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD): woh oxygen jo pani ke organic aur inorganic substances ko oxidising agents (KMnO₄, K₂Cr₂O₇ waghera) se chemically oxidise karne ke liye chahiye. Zyada COD ka matlab pani mein oxidise hone wale chemical pollutants zyada hain, yani pani kharab hai aur shayad industry ya gharon ke waste se ganda hua hai. COD se pani ka kul pollution load (total bojh) naapa jata hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Table ko oopar se neeche parhein: pani jitna ganda hota jata hai, DO kam aur BOD aur COD zyada hoti jati hai. Saaf pani mein oxygen zyada hai kyun ke use kharch karne wala organic matter kam hai.

Redox potential batata hai ke koi water body (pani ka zakhira) kitna oxidising ya reducing hai. Achhi oxygen wale pani mein chemical species apni sab se oxidised shakal mein hoti hain, jaise SO₄²⁻ aur CO₂. Lekin polluted ya thehre hue (stagnant) pani mein oxygen khatam ho jati hai aur mahol reducing ban jata hai. Is se toxic substances (zehreele maadde) bante hain, jaise hydrogen sulphide (H₂S) aur ammonia (NH₃). In chemical equilibria aur H₂O ke molecular behaviour (molecules ke rawaiye) ko samajh kar hum predict kar sakte (andaza laga sakte) hain ke koi khaas pollutant kahan jayega (migrate), kis cheez mein badlega (transform) aur duniya ki pani ki supply par kya asar dalega.

blocks.prompt: i. Samjhayein ke pani ki polarity pesticides jaise agricultural pollutants (kheti se aane wali gandagi) ko water cycle mein pohanchane mein kaise madad karti hai.
blocks.explanation: Pani polar hai, is liye polar organic compounds aur ions ko ghol leta hai. Polar pesticides aur herbicides barish aur behte pani mein ghul kar daryaon, jheelon aur zameen ke neeche ke pani tak pohanch jate hain aur wahan der tak rehte hain.

blocks.prompt: ii. Pani ki quality ke indicators ke taur par BOD (kitab yahan 'Biological Oxygen Demand' likhti hai; upar text mein 'Biochemical') aur COD mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: BOD woh oxygen hai jo microorganisms organic matter torne mein use karte hain (20°C par paanch din); yeh sirf gal sakne wali organic pollution naapti hai. COD woh oxygen hai jo KMnO₄ ya K₂Cr₂O₇ jaise oxidising agents se organic aur inorganic dono substances ko chemically oxidise karne mein lagti hai; yeh kul pollution load naapti hai. Is liye COD aam taur par BOD se zyada hoti hai.

items: Pani permanent dipole hai; hydrogen bonds se thermal stability aur solvent ki taqat aati hai.
Amphoteric: 25°C par Kw = 1.0 × 10⁻¹⁴; acid rain se H₃O⁺ barhta aur zehreeli metals pani mein aati hain.
Zyada DO = saaf pani; zyada BOD aur COD = polluted pani (Table 33.1).
Oxygen khatam ho to reducing halaat: H₂S aur NH₃ bante hain.
